repairs.quote: Illaoi smashes her idol into the ground, dealing (150/250/350 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to nearby enemies and spawning a Tentacle for each enemy champion hit. For the next 8 seconds, Tentacles are untargetable and Slam 50% faster, and Harsh Lesson has a 2 second cooldown. Spirits from Test Of Spirit also generate a Tentacle if hit by this ability.
